title: Remove Landing troubleshooting section and clean up LandingPage imports

requirements.summary: Remove the “Troubleshooting Access Issues” section from the unauthenticated Landing page while preserving the remaining section order and layout.
acceptanceCriteria: The Landing page no longer renders a section titled “Troubleshooting Access Issues”.
No Landing page content mentions “Canister ID Not Resolved” or “Error 400”.
No Landing page content displays the URL `https://genz-app.icp0.io` as part of troubleshooting guidance.
The page layout still renders correctly with the remaining sections (Hero, Platform Stats, Featured Providers, Testimonials, Features, About) in the expected order.

file_operations.description: Delete the entire JSX block for the “Troubleshooting Access Issues” section (heading, explanatory text, displayed URL, and instruction list) so the Landing page renders Hero followed immediately by Platform Stats, then Featured Providers, Testimonials, Features, and About (same order as before).

requirements.summary: Remove unused imports/code left behind in LandingPage after deleting the troubleshooting section.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx` has no unused imports related to the removed troubleshooting section.
The frontend builds without lint/type errors caused by the removal.

file_operations.description: Remove any now-unused imports and variables introduced solely for the troubleshooting section (e.g., remove the `AlertCircle` icon import from `lucide-react` if it is no longer referenced) and ensure the file has no unused import warnings.
